name: Harvest Moon Heart Strings
source:
You play as Lian Hua, an herbalist in a small village in China during the fall. Hua is stressed by her new responsibilities of running the shop by herself and wonders if there's more to life.  However, one night while she's out gathering materials, she runs into a strange woman who is both beautiful and oddly familiar. 

[From [url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/harvest-moon-heart-strings-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演莲华——秋日中国某座偏远小山村里的一名草药师。独自挑起打理药铺的新重担令她倍感压力，不禁暗自思索人生是否还有别的可能。然而某天夜晚，外出采药的她偶遇了一名陌生的女子——对方不仅美貌动人，更透着一股奇异的熟悉感。

[摘自[url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/harvest-moon-heart-strings-demo]itch.io[/url]]
